mapper.sql: p.principal_id,p.name,p.status,p.revision,p.credential_version, p.key_hash,p.key_prefix,p.signing_secret_encrypted,p.created_by_ref,p.created_at,p.updated_at, coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(s.action ORDER BY s.action) FROM nw_platform_management_scopes s WHERE s.principal_id=p.principal_id),'[]'::jsonb) AS scopes, coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(t.target_value ORDER BY t.target_value) FROM nw_platform_management_targets t WHERE t.principal_id=p.principal_id AND t.kind='tenant'),'[]'::jsonb) AS target_tenant_ids, coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(t.target_value ORDER BY t.target_value) FROM nw_platform_management_targets t WHERE t.principal_id=p.principal_id AND t.kind='agent_definition'),'[]'::jsonb) AS target_definition_ids, coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(t.target_value ORDER BY t.target_value) FROM nw_platform_management_targets t WHERE t.principal_id=p.principal_id AND t.kind='namespace'),'[]'::jsonb) AS target_namespaces

SELECT FROM nw_platform_management_principals p WHERE p.key_hash=#{keyHash}

choose.otherwise: (p.created_by_ref=concat('platform_member:',#{filter.memberId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_member_profiles m WHERE m.scope_key='platform' AND concat('platform_member:',m.member_id)=p.created_by_ref AND m.department_id::text IN #{department}))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_platform_management_principals p WHERE ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.principal_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.update: UPDATE nw_platform_management_principals SET key_hash=#{keyHash},key_prefix=#{keyPrefix},signing_secret_encrypted=#{secret},credential_version=credential_version+1,revision=revision+1,updated_at=now() WHERE principal_id=#{principalId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND status='active'

UPDATE nw_platform_management_principals SET status='revoked',signing_secret_encrypted=NULL,credential_version=credential_version+1,revision=revision+1,updated_at=now() WHERE principal_id=#{principalId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND status='active'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_platform_management_receipts(actor_ref,operation,object_scope,idempotency_key,fingerprint) VALUES(#{actorRef},#{operation},#{objectScope},#{key},#{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT fingerprint,result_json::text FROM nw_platform_management_receipts WHERE actor_ref=#{actorRef} AND operation=#{operation} AND object_scope=#{objectScope} AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_platform_management_receipts SET result_json=CAST(#{result} AS jsonb) WHERE actor_ref=#{actorRef} AND operation=#{operation} AND object_scope=#{objectScope} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND result_json IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE t.id=#{id})
mapper.sql: ((g.grantee_type='member' AND g.grantee_id::text=#{filter.memberId}) OR (g.grantee_type='department' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_member_profiles m JOIN nw_foundation_departments d ON d.scope_key=m.scope_key AND d.id=m.department_id AND d.enabled WHERE m.scope_key='platform' AND m.member_id::text=#{filter.memberId} AND m.department_id=g.grantee_id)) OR (g.grantee_type='role' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_member_roles mr JOIN nw_foundation_roles r ON r.scope_key=mr.scope_key AND r.id=mr.role_id AND r.enabled WHERE mr.scope_key='platform' AND mr.member_id::text=#{filter.memberId} AND mr.role_id=g.grantee_id)))
